title: Save all hardware information to a file
summary: Use hwinfo to write a complete report of all detected hardware components to a text file for later review or sharing.

aliases.text: сохранить информацию об оборудовании в файл

steps.explain: Run hwinfo with --all and --log to write all hardware information to the specified file path.

placeholders.name: FILE
placeholders.description: The path to the file where the hardware report will be saved.
